description: This PHP source file provides the webpage for adding a new blocked service in a parental control or managed services configuration interface. It includes header and navigation components, a form for inputting service details (name, protocol, port range, scheduling, and days), and JavaScript code to handle form validation, UI interactions, and AJAX submission for saving the new blocked service.

methods.name: updateBlockTimeVisibility
methods.description: A JavaScript function that enables or disables the schedule input fields based on whether the 'Always Block' switch is on or off.
